# Display

For faster mobile-friendly development, use responsive display classes
for showing and hiding elements by device.<br />
See the supported <LinkTo kind="General/Layout/Introduction" story="docs">breakpoints</LinkTo>

Note: the examples below are best experienced in a separate window.

<Primary />

To hide elements simply use the `.ds-d--none` class or one of the
`.ds-d-{breakpoint}--none` classes for any responsive screen variation.

To show an element only on a given interval of screen sizes
you can combine a `.ds-d-*--none` class with a `.ds-d-*--*` class,
for example `.ds-d--none .ds-d-lg--block .ds-d-xxl--none` will show the element
only on large screens.
